props.name: align
props.description: Alignment of the content along the cross axis relative to the anchor: `'start'`, `'center'` or `'end'`.

props.name: children
props.description: Composed trigger and content primitives.

props.name: classes
props.description: Family slot class defaults for this instance.

props.name: closeOnEscape
props.description:
Whether pressing Escape closes the menu. When `false`, Escape is ignored and `onClosePrevented`
is called.

props.name: closeOnOutsideClick
props.description:
Whether a pointer press or focus move outside the menu closes it. When `false`, the attempt
is ignored and `onClosePrevented` is called.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Initial open state when uncontrolled. Ignored when `open` is set.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables the context menu: right-click, long press and keyboard opening no longer open it, the native browser menu shows instead, and an open menu closes.

props.name: flip
props.description:
Whether the content moves to the opposite side when the preferred `placement` does not fit.
An array such as `['top', 'left']` is an ordered list of fallback `Placement` values tried
in order (`top`, `bottom`, `left` or `right`, each optionally followed by `-start` or `-end`).

props.name: gutter
props.description: Distance in pixels between the anchor and the content along the placement axis.

props.name: id
props.description:
Base for the generated trigger and content ids; the content id is `<id>-content`. Generated
when omitted.

props.name: mount
props.description:
DOM node the portal mounts into. Defaults to `document.body` (resolved from the trigger's
document when available).

props.name: onClosePrevented
props.description:
Called when Escape or an outside interaction tries to close the menu but `closeOnEscape` or
`closeOnOutsideClick` is `false`.

props.name: onExitComplete
props.description:
Called once each time the overlay finishes its exit after closing. It is not called while the
overlay is open.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description:
Called with the next open state when the user opens or closes the menu, and when `disabled`
becomes `true` while it is open. It fires in controlled and uncontrolled mode alike, so a
controlled menu must write the value back to `open`.

props.name: open
props.description:
Controlled open state. While `undefined` the menu is uncontrolled and follows `defaultOpen`;
update it from `onOpenChange`.

props.name: overflowPadding
props.description:
Minimum distance in pixels kept between the content and the viewport edge when `flip` and
`slide` position it.

props.name: placement
props.description:
Preferred side of the pointer position (or the center of the trigger when opened from the keyboard) the content opens on (`'top'`, `'right'`, `'bottom'` or `'left'`).
The content may move to another side when `flip` is enabled and the preferred side lacks space.

props.name: preventScroll
props.description: Locks body scroll while the menu is open. Set `false` to keep the page scrollable.

props.name: shift
props.description: Offset in pixels along the cross axis, applied on top of `align`.

props.name: size
props.description: Visual size of menu items.

props.name: slide
props.description:
Whether the content may slide along the edge of the anchor so it stays inside the viewport
instead of being clipped.

props.name: styles
props.description: Family slot style defaults for this instance.

props.name: as
props.description: Element or component to render as.

props.name: children
props.description: Trigger label and visual content.

props.name: class
props.description: Class applied to the component root or trigger element.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Whether this trigger is disabled.

props.name: style
props.description: Style applied to the component root or trigger element.

parts.name: ContextMenu.Content
parts.description: Props for the ContextMenu content component.

props.name: checkedIcon
props.description: Icon shown on checked checkbox and radio items.

props.name: class
props.description: Class applied to the component root or trigger element.

props.name: expandIcon
props.description: Icon shown at the end of items that open a submenu.

props.name: footerRender
props.description:
Content rendered below the item groups, in the root menu and in every submenu. A function is
mounted as a component and receives `{ sub }`, which is `true` inside a submenu.

props.name: headerRender
props.description:
Content rendered above the item groups, in the root menu and in every submenu. A function is
mounted as a component and receives `{ sub }`, which is `true` inside a submenu.
examples:
import { ContextMenu } from 'moraine' Open
{props.sub ? 'More actions' : 'Actions'}
} />

props.name: itemRender
props.description:
Replaces the inner content of every item row (icon, label, description, shortcut keys, submenu
indicator and checkmark); the row keeps its role, keyboard handling and selection. It is
mounted as a component and receives `item`, `depth` (`0` in the root menu, `1` and up in
submenus) and `hasChildren`. Read `item.type` to tell checkbox and radio items apart.

props.name: items
props.description:
Items rendered in the menu body. Each entry is an item object or an array of items; consecutive
plain entries form one group, and every array starts a new group, with a separator drawn
between groups. An item's `type` is `'item'` (the default), `'checkbox'`, `'radio-group'`
(with radio `items`), `'group'` (with a `label` and child `items`) or `'separator'`. An `'item'`
with `children` opens a submenu, `danger` marks a destructive item, and `onSelect` runs
when an item is activated.
examples:
import { createSignal } from 'solid-js'
import { ContextMenu } from 'moraine'

const [showHidden, setShowHidden] = createSignal(false)

<ContextMenu>
  <ContextMenu.Trigger>Open</ContextMenu.Trigger>
  <ContextMenu.Content
    items={[
      [{ label: 'Rename', onSelect: () => console.log('rename') }, { label: 'Delete', danger: true }],
      [{ type: 'checkbox', label: 'Show hidden', checked: showHidden(), onCheckedChange: setShowHidden }],
      { label: 'Share', children: [{ label: 'Copy link' }] },
    ]}
  />
</ContextMenu>

props.name: style
props.description: Style applied to the component root or trigger element.

props.name: checked
props.description:
Controlled checked state. Leave it `undefined` to let the item manage its own state (see
`defaultChecked`); when set, update it from `onCheckedChange`.

props.name: children
props.description:
Items of the submenu, in the same shape as the menu `items` (flat items and `group` objects).
A non-empty list makes the item open a submenu instead of calling `onSelect`, and shows the
menu's `expandIcon` in place of `kbds`. Only items without a `type` (or with `type: 'item'`)
open submenus; on `group` and `radio-group` items `items` holds the group's entries.
examples:
import { Button, DropdownMenu } from 'moraine'

<DropdownMenu>
  <DropdownMenu.Trigger as={Button}>Share</DropdownMenu.Trigger>
  <DropdownMenu.Content
    items={[
      { label: 'Copy link', onSelect: () => console.log('copied') },
      { label: 'Send to', children: [{ label: 'Email' }, { label: 'Slack' }] },
    ]}
  />
</DropdownMenu>

props.name: class
props.description: Custom CSS class applied to the item element.

props.name: danger
props.description:
Whether the item is a destructive action. `danger` items use the danger text color and set
`data-danger` on the item.

props.name: defaultChecked
props.description: Initial checked state when `checked` is not set.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Initial open state of the submenu when `open` is not set.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initial selected value when `value` is not set.

props.name: description
props.description: Secondary text shown below the label.

props.name: disabled
props.description:
Whether the item is non-interactive: it ignores activation (no `onSelect`, no closing) and
exposes `aria-disabled`.

props.name: icon
props.description: Name of the icon shown at the start of the item.

props.name: items
props.description:
Radio items in this group. Selecting one unchecks the others. The group's `label`, when set,
is rendered as its heading.

props.name: kbds
props.description:
Keys shown as keycaps at the end of the item, for example `['ctrl', 's']`. Each key is resolved
like `Kbd` `value`, so names such as `meta` or `shift` render as symbols. Display only: it does
not register a keyboard shortcut. Not shown on items that open a submenu.

props.name: label
props.description:
Text or element shown as the item's primary text. A string `label` is also what typeahead
matches; otherwise the item's rendered text is used. When the menu content has an `itemRender`,
it replaces the default rendering of `label`, `description`, `icon` and `kbds`.

props.name: onCheckedChange
props.description: Called with the next checked state each time the user toggles the item. The menu stays open.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description:
Called with the next open state when the submenu opens (pointer hover delay, click or arrow
key) or closes. Not called when `open` is changed from outside.

props.name: onSelect
props.description:
Called when the item is activated by click, Enter or Space, before the whole menu closes and
focus returns to the trigger. Not called for disabled items or items that open a submenu.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the `value` of the radio item the user chose. The menu stays open.

props.name: open
props.description:
Controlled open state of the submenu. Only applies to items with `children`; leave it
`undefined` to let the item manage its own state (see `defaultOpen`).

props.name: style
props.description: Custom inline styles applied to the item element.

props.name: value
props.description:
Controlled selected value, matched against each radio item's `value`. Leave it `undefined`
to let the group manage its own state (see `defaultValue`).
